Homework exercise · Week 5

Starry Sky

Scratch (offline app) Work in pairs

Goal: make a My Block star (size) and use it to fill the night sky. Time: about 10 minutes. Tool: Scratch app (offline) with the Pen extension.

Build steps

  1. Open Scratch and add the Pen extension. Choose a dark backdrop (for example Stars, or paint the backdrop dark blue).
  2. My Blocks > Make a Block: name it star, add an input size, click OK.
  3. Build both scripts. Drag size out of the define hat into the move block.
  4. For the pen color, click the color circle and set Color 16, Saturation 72, Brightness 94 (yellow from the color-safe paint box).
  5. Click the green flag. Save as starry-sky.

The scripts in words

define star (size)

  • pen down
  • repeat 5:
    • move (size) steps
    • turn right 144 degrees
  • pen up

when green flag clicked

  • erase all
  • set pen color to (yellow)
  • set pen size to 3
  • pen up
  • hide
  • repeat 10:
    • go to random position
    • star (pick random 10 to 60)

Expected behavior

Each click on the green flag clears the sky and draws 10 yellow five-pointed stars in surprise places, each a different size. There are no lines joining the stars. The cat is hidden.

Checklist

Stuck? Open a hint

Try on your own first. Hints open one at a time, from a small nudge to a bigger one. None of them gives the answer away.

Hint 1: Where to look

A star is just a shape you can draw by moving and turning. Put that drawing in your own star block, so you can use it many times. The Motion and Pen categories have the drawing blocks.

Hint 2: Try this

A five-pointed star uses the same two steps five times: move, then turn. The turn is bigger than you might think. Put the size oval in the move block so each star can be a different size.

Hint 3: Almost there

In the define block, use pen down, then repeat ____ with move (size) steps and turn right ____ degrees inside, then pen up. In the flag script, use go to random position (Motion category) and then star (pick random ____ to ____). Use pen up before the loop so no lines join the stars.
